desc:
💼 From your first day at work to life after hours, build your own city life!

Apply for jobs, interview, and join a company. Complete tasks, meet coworkers, earn promotions, and negotiate your salary.

🚌 Commute by bus, taxi, or your own car
💻 Take on different tasks in every department
🥩 Enjoy meals and gatherings with coworkers
🛒 Shop for groceries and cook at home
🏠 Build a daily routine with your fridge and wardrobe
📈 Manage your paycheck, bills, banking, and stocks

Will you become the star employee, or make the most of your life after work?
Your choices shape the city in New Employee.

Music is not used to generate revenue. Paid items provide convenience features. Tracks may change or be removed at a rights holder's request.

This game is still in development. Content and systems may change with updates.
